title: timetable2table
summary: Convert a timetable into a table.
description: `timetable2table(TT)` converts a timetable to a table and places the row-time vector in the first table variable.
behaviors: Row times are converted by default and prepended as a `Time` variable. Set `"ConvertRowTimes"` to `false` to discard them.
Variable order, native integer classes, exact payloads, and row names are preserved.

examples.description: Convert Row Times To A Table Variable
